snippet.title: Total Chaos | Music by Akira Yamaoka “Catharsis” | Official Preview
snippet.description:
Play the free demo of Total Chaos: ► https://PlayTotalChaos.com
Legendary Silent Hill composer Akira Yamaoka has joined forces with Apogee Entertainment and Trigger Happy Interactive to bring his haunting sound to Total Chaos, the highly anticipated standalone survival horror game from the creator of Turbo Overkill.

To celebrate Halloween, we’re unveiling a first listen to Yamaoka’s chilling original track, “Catharsis,” written exclusively for Total Chaos. This one-minute preview showcases the unsettling atmosphere and dread-filled ambiance that define the horrors of Fort Oasis.

Total Chaos began as a DOOM II total conversion mod before evolving into a full psychological survival horror experience. Developed by Sam Prebble, a former Weta FX artist who worked on Avatar, The Hobbit, and Rise of the Planet of the Apes, this definitive edition pulls players into a terrifying journey through isolation, decay, and madness.

Features
• Original music by Akira Yamaoka (Silent Hill)
• Atmospheric soundtrack from Jason Dagenet, Chipper Hammond, Tim Stoney & Mathieu Hallouin
• Nine terrifying chapters of survival horror gameplay
• A deep inventory and crafting system
• Eerie environmental storytelling and horrifying enemy encounters
• VR support coming post-launch
